comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Beauty World MRT about 220 m, King Albert Park MRT about 1,200 m; closer than 555 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Pei Hwa Presbyterian Primary School about 410 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 210 m), more than 132 of 662 similar developments (the same as 18); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Interim Hawker Centre And Market about 170 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 460 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Bukit Timah Interim Hawker Centre And Market

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (8@BT, 34 new sales, about 370 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 440 m; The Sen, 177 new sales, about 930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 70 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 213 new sales and 399 resales (612 purchases); new sales were 34.8% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 399 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 89 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 399 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 411 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2.9%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
